'''Ubrikkian Arms''' was a subsidiary of [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]] that manufactured arms such as the [[L60 blaster rifle/Legends|L60 blaster rifle]], a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by [[Toydarian royal guard]]s.<ref name="TCWCE" />
